description_one_sentence: One row per registered ShopFast customer with identity, contact details, address, birth date, marketing consent and loyalty tier.
issues_spotted: Duplicate customer_id (8 ids appear twice, 8 exact duplicate rows); missing email (48) and phone (30); country coded inconsistently (FR/fr/France/france /FRA/Allemagne/Germany... 18 variants, 37 empty); mixed birth_date and signup_date formats (174 and 303 non-ISO) with implausible birth years (1899, 2031); inconsistent loyalty_tier (GOLD/Gold/Platinium/'silver '); malformed emails (28) and postal codes (48 not 5 digits); 5+ phone formats

description_one_sentence: Product catalogue listing each sellable item with SKU, name, category, list price, supplier and active flag.
issues_spotted: Inconsistent category labels (trailing spaces, 'electronics', 'SPORTS': 11 variants for 6 categories); missing unit_price_eur (product 506 Mechanical Keyboard); duplicate SKU SF-FAS-0522 on products 501 and 522, and SKU 'FAS' prefix does not match category Electronics for 501

description_one_sentence: One row per customer order with date, status, sales channel, shipping country and total amount.
issues_spotted: Duplicate order_id (7 exact duplicate rows, 5200 distinct ids); missing order_date (11) and 5 future-dated orders (up to 2027-03-13); inconsistent status values (SHIPPED/Delivered/'delivered '/canceled vs cancelled); 14 orders reference customer_ids absent from customers; 6 orders with total_amount_eur <= 0; total_amount_eur differs from sum of order_items for 876 orders; 298 orders have no payment. Note: contains personal data indirectly (customer_id links to a person = pseudonymised data under GDPR)

description_one_sentence: One row per product line within an order, with quantity and unit price at time of sale.
issues_spotted: Invalid quantities (6 negative = -1, 2 zero); 4 lines reference product_id 999 that does not exist in products; unit_price_eur differs from the catalogue price in products for 165 lines (may be legitimate price changes) and line totals do not match orders.total_amount_eur for 876 orders; order_id repeated by design (5200 orders, 9193 lines) so no natural unique key besides order_item_id; no personal data itself but linkable to a customer through order_id

description_one_sentence: One row per payment transaction on an order, with method, amount, currency, partial card number and status (captured/refunded).
issues_spotted: Missing values: card_last4 empty for 1,059 payments made by card; card_last4 populated for non-card methods (paypal, bank_transfer, apple_pay) which is inconsistent; 298 orders have no payment record; 6 payments whose amount differs from order total; 4 payments dated before their order date; 1 captured payment on a cancelled order; payment data is sensitive (card digits, financial) -> PCI/GDPR minimisation needed

description_one_sentence: One row per customer support request (chat, phone or email) with subject, free-text message and agent notes.
issues_spotted: Personal data leaks into free text: phone numbers and first names in message (~356 tickets), birth dates in agent_notes (62), subjects often do not match message content (e.g. 'Delete my account' with a delivery-slot question); 47 'Delete my account' tickets = GDPR erasure requests to trace; agent_notes empty for 150 tickets and contains subjective remarks ('Customer angry, escalate.'); unstructured text hard to anonymise

description_one_sentence: Export of 600 customers (id, email, first name, tier) targeted by the spring_2026 marketing campaign.
issues_spotted: Redundant copy of customer data (email, first name, tier) that can drift: 29 emails differ from customers.csv; single campaign value (spring_2026) with no export date or consent/opt-in column; consent not recorded in the file itself (all 600 customers do have marketing_consent = true in customers.csv, so the check passes but must be repeated at each export); no export date or lineage metadata
